data.summary:
Strategic and results-driven Senior Product Owner with 12+ years of experience in FinTech, BFSI, NBFC, and Commercial Payments, delivering enterprise-scale payment products for US banking clients. Deep expertise across Commercial Cards, ACH, Wire Transfers, Settlement workflows, B2B Payment Products, API-led integrations, and payment modernization initiatives including ISO 20022 (PAIN flow). Proven track record of managing cross-functional Agile teams of 10+ members, translating complex business requirements into scalable digital products, and driving operational efficiency, stakeholder alignment, and measurable business outcomes.
Recognized for combining product thinking, business analysis expertise, and execution leadership to deliver high-impact payment capabilities such as Virtual Card Prefunding solutions that improved client funding visibility and payment transparency for B2B commercial customers.

raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Product Owner – Commercial Payments | FIS | Pune
July 2021 – Present
Own product backlog prioritization and roadmap execution for commercial payment products spanning Commercial Cards, ACH, Wire Transfers, and Settlement workflows aligned to strategic client needs.
Manage a cross-functional Agile squad across Engineering, QA, and Business Analysis for
enterprise payment delivery initiatives serving US banking clients.
Delivered ISO 20022 payment modernization initiative (PAIN flow) by defining business requirements, workflow redesign, and integration priorities supporting payment message standardization and interoperability readiness.
Successfully launched Virtual Card Prefunding capability for B2B commercial customers, improving client funding visibility, transaction transparency, and overall payment experience.
Partner with stakeholders, engineering leadership, and client teams to convert business goals into product requirements, prioritized backlog items, and execution-ready user stories.
Facilitate backlog grooming, sprint planning, UAT sign-off, release readiness reviews, and
cross-team dependency management for multiple concurrent initiatives.
Supported API-led payment integrations and workflow automation initiatives that
enhanced operational efficiency and strengthened payment lifecycle visibility.
Key Achievements: ✔ Delivered multiple high-impact payment initiatives on schedule
✔ Improved payment workflow visibility for enterprise B2B customers
✔ Enabled modernization readiness through ISO 20022 implementation
✔ Strengthened Agile execution and delivery predictability across teams
Business Analyst – Investment Banking | 3i Infotech | Mumbai
Aug 2020 – Jul 2021
Collaborated with Product Owners and business stakeholders to analyze operational
processes and recommend scalable digital solutions.
Authored business requirements, user stories, process flows, and test scenarios to
support product delivery.
Supported API integration programs to enable seamless enterprise data exchange across
platforms.
Worked closely with Development and QA teams to reduce delivery risks and improve
release quality.
Facilitated Agile ceremonies, backlog prioritization discussions, and business validation
sessions.
Business Analyst – BFSI / NBFC | Datamatics | Pune
May 2017 – Apr 2020

Led business requirement elicitation, process analysis, and as-is / to-be workflow mapping for financial transformation initiatives.
Conducted vendor evaluation and solution recommendation exercises based on business
fit, integration capability, and cost efficiency.
Provided analytical support for financial planning, forecasting, and operational decision-
making.
Managed UAT support, business documentation, and end-user enablement activities.
Senior Executive – PMO | L&T Finance | Pune
May 2014 – May 2017
Converted business needs into BRD / FRD documentation, enabling smooth
collaboration between business and technology teams.

Improved business process efficiency through workflow redesign initiatives.

Led UAT coordination, defect tracking, and release readiness activities for enterprise programs.
Managed project governance coordination across business, IT, and infrastructure teams.
